changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6f, item 5 (R50): a Feishu extension's state root now nests under the Feishu plugin's own state directory (ServerHost.stateDir, captured in plugin.ts's server()) plus the dispatcher id, instead of the channel instance's state_root it borrowed before. access.json, chat-bots.json, and the routing document are untouched; this mechanism has not shipped in a release.
